title: Media Cache: Purge the Local Copy of Remote Media | Orchard Core
description:
When media files live in Azure Blob Storage or Amazon S3, your Orchard Core site keeps a local copy of each file it serves. That copy takes disk space, and it can hold files you want the site to download again.

The Media Cache feature adds a page under Settings, Media, Cache, with a Purge All action that empties the local copy. The Manage Asset Cache Folder permission controls the page, and two background tasks can clean the caches on a schedule.
